cells.gaps: Preparation rests on announcements of July 2026 and an undated memorandum of understanding: no design, procurement, pilot office or start date for a digital system is described, and whether the Juba birth-registration pilot (SSD-023, SSD-024) is digital is not stated. No dated statement that local offices register on paper only is held outside the excluded source (SSD-019), so stage 1 is not claimed. On the plan, SSD-022 (December 2025) says a costed CRVS plan was adopted but gives it no period, against SSD-013 (July 2026), which describes recommendations and no plan in force.
cells.note: Stage 2 because the Directorate announced a digital civil registration system in July 2026 and the World Bank lists it as planned only (SSD-014, SSD-015). Not stage 3: no birth is registered digitally in any office.
